text:
Alex: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we identified two recurring patterns (nightly throughput dip around 03:00 UTC, and noon p95 spikes). Need a short remediation plan and owners for SLO tweaks.
Maya: I can take the dashboard and alert changes. I'll add a panel for per-model variant p95 and a burn-rate alert.
Jon: Thx. Can you include a time-of-day breakdown? the nocturnal dip looks like autopause-triggering on low-util nodes.
Maya: Yep, will add heatmap by hour and an annotation for autoscaler events.
Priya: Proposal: set p95 SLO for text-gen (interactive) to 220ms during business hours, relax to 300ms for 02:00-06:00 UTC. Also add a throughput SLO for batch endpoints: 180 qps sustained. Thoughts?
Samir: +1 on the time-windowed SLOs, but we should tie the error-budget policy to fallback rules. If budget burn > 20% in 1h, auto-fallback to the smaller quantized model.
Emily: Agree. From product side, we want graceful degradation not hard failures. Add a dashboard card that shows active fallback routes and their traffic %.
Alex: Good. Let's capture action items and dates: 1) Dashboard + alerts (Maya) — EOD Thu 2024-04-11, 2) SLO config + policy doc (Priya) — Mon 2024-04-15, 3) Auto-fallback playbook (Samir) — Wed 2024-04-17, 4) Eval run to check quality regression on quantized model (Jon) — Thu 2024-04-18.
Maya: I'll create the Grafana panels and a json export. Sample query I'll use for p95 by variant:```quantile_over_time(0.95, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="inference",variant!=""}[5m])) by (le,variant)))```
Jon: For throughput SLO I recommend a rolling-5m QPS measurement:```sum(rate(requests_total{job="inference",route=~"/batch.*"}[5m]))``` and set threshold at 180.
Priya: Who owns updating the SLO metadata in the control plane (customer-facing SLA doc + internal SLO config)? Alex or me?
Alex: Priya takes the customer-facing doc, I'll update internal control-plane config and tie the alerting signal to the error-budget dashboard.
Samir: Operational note — autoscaler logs show scale-down at 02:45 UTC correlated with lost steady-state qps. I'll add a cooldown change and add a runbook step to check node draining metrics before pause.
Maya: Created a stub dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/example/d/slo-postmortem - I'll add panels and let you know when ready for review. :eyes:
Jon: Can we add a daily synthetic at 02:30 to keep one pod warm? That might prevent the dip while we adjust autoscaler.
Samir: Good idea. I'll schedule a simple ping job and measure cost impact.
Emily: Product asks for a weekly note to customers if we change SLA windows. Priya pls draft a short paragraph by Thu.
Priya: Will do.
Alex: OK — owners and dates confirmed. We'll reconvene next Tue 2024-04-16 09:00 UTC to check progress and error-budget burn. If anyone hits blockers, drop quick updates here.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: 1745503001 — latency spike resolved, postmortem published: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/1745503001 - follow-ups assigned.
Maya: Thanks — marking action items in the handbook and assigning Jira tickets now. :white_check_mark:
Jon: I'll kick off the eval runs after Maya's dashboard is up so we can correlate metrics.
Samir: Noted. I'll also add the autoscaler cooldown change to the deployment PR and link it here.
Alex: Great. Closing this thread for now — moving detailed tasks to Jira but keep any quick blockers here.
